body.text: This is not one of my letters asking. The {perception:northern_front} north has gone past asking, and a requisition has been set against your colony.
{param:amount} of {param:resource}, inside {param:months} months. I am told your colony makes it. I am not told whether your colony will part with it, which is rather the whole of my difficulty.
You have {param:turns_left} more posts in which to answer. I mention the number because men in your position tend to read a deadline as an opening bid.
If you have any sense you will write to whoever actually holds the stuff before you write to me. He is the man who decides, whatever the two of us put on paper.
I would rather have a plain refusal by the next post than a yes I have to chase across a winter.
Your predecessor understood what the Crown's wars cost. He understood it late.

options.text: in the very best of humours
short of both time and patience
at the very end of my means
exactly as you intended it to

options.label: undertake the full {param:amount}
options.text: You shall have {param:amount} of {param:resource} inside {param:months} months{insert:barb}. I will write to the town this week, and you may hold me to it — though you will understand that I am now holding somebody else to it in turn.

barb.annoyed: , though it beggars the colony to do it

options.label: decline plainly, and now
options.text: The colony can spare nothing this season{insert:apology}. I would rather tell you today than have you counting crates in the spring that were never coming.

apology.desperate: , and I am sorry for it

tone.hateful: Do not write to me again this season.
